articles.summary: Cineverse (Nasdaq: CNVS), an entertainment technology company and studio, announced - in partnership with DFB (German Football Federation) its new streaming channel, German Soccer Network. It is now available in the U.S. as a premium free, ad-supported streaming television (FAST) channel, exclusively on LG Channels. The exclusive new channel will air live matches showcasing the best German football clubs, including all Bundesliga teams – one of the top soccer leagues in the world. Matches will air periodically throughout the year and include the DFB-Pokal, a German knockout football cup competition that represents the most important club title in German football after the Bundesliga championship. German Soccer Network will have comprehensive live coverage of the DFB-Pokal, which resumes with the second round on October 27 and 28 and continues through the May final, and will also include live matches featuring the 3 Liga, the World Cup favorite German Women's National Team, and more.
articles.title: Cineverse to Launch New 24/7 German Soccer Network, Available Exclusively on LG Channels

articles.summary: Cineverse (Nasdaq: CNVS), an entertainment technology company and studio, announced today the addition of both SVOD (subscription video-on-demand) access to SCREAMBOX and Dove Channel on DIRECTV. SCREAMBOX features a broad mix of content for casual and die-hard horror fans alike. The service is refreshed monthly with content from the Company's extensive genre library with films and episodes delivering every type of terror imaginable. SCREAMBOX currently features classic horror films like Black Christmas , slasher hits Terrifier 2 and 3 as well as the BBC series Bedlam and Being Human. Dove Channel features a lineup of films and series sending viewers on an escape to romance and excitement, where heartwarming tales, light-hearted love stories, and holiday escapes await. Dove is your streaming home away from home. articles.summary: From the Mind Behind Siren Head and Cartoon Cat, and one of the Hottest Indie Creators, with Recent Studio Deals with Warner Bros. and TriStar Cineverse (Nasdaq: CNVS), an entertainment technology company and studio, has made a deal with Trevor Henderson , creator of Siren Head and Cartoon Cat , to adapt the hit horror podcast Mayfair Watchers Society into a feature film. Downloaded more than three million times since premiering on audio on October 10, 2022, the Mayfair Watchers Society story will continue both on the big screen and through the podcast, which premieres its fourth season soon with the Cineverse Podcast Network. This agreement comes at a time during which Hollywood demand for Henderson's viral online creations has exploded. Earlier this year, Warner Bros. Pictures won a bidding war to turn Henderson's Siren Head character into a movie, with Zach Cregger and Brian Duffield attached.
